description: Source code for SSL platform key utilities, including key extraction, padding, and task runner management within the Chromium project.

classes.name: SSLPlatformKeyTaskRunner
classes.description: Manages a dedicated thread for SSL platform key operations.

methods.name: SSLPlatformKeyTaskRunner
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and starts the worker thread.

methods.name: task_runner
methods.description: Returns the task runner associated with the worker thread.

methods.name: GetSSLPlatformKeyTaskRunner
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton task runner for SSL platform key tasks.

methods.name: GetClientCertPublicKey
methods.description: Extracts the public key from an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: GetClientCertInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the key type and maximum length of the client certificate's public key.

methods.name: AddPSSPadding
methods.description: Adds PSS padding to a digest using the specified public key and hash.
